pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Dark contiguous regions exhibiting irregular polygonal geometry with smooth-to-moderate pixel gradients at the boundaries. Larger spatial area is observed on the central flank, transitioning to significantly reduced spatial area at the posterior-ventral margin.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Light-toned negative-space network forming a continuous graph. Junction nodes are primarily tri-radial with occasional quadri-radial intersections. Pixel thickness is highest at the mid-flank and decreases toward the hindquarters.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: A continuous, low-amplitude serrated silhouette along the dorsal ridge. Individual hair tufts create a fine-grained, high-frequency jagged contour against the background.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a small, dark avian subject perched on the dorsal ridge at the cranial-dorsal junction.
